advancements.arcanity.story.level_up.des: Level up an enchantment by collecting enough experience
enchantment.arcanity.abundance.descripti: Mobs and blocks have a chance to drop more loot.
enchantment.arcanity.blaze.description: Sets enemies on fire and smelts the drops of blocks.
enchantment.arcanity.collect.description: Directly inserts drops into your inventory.
enchantment.arcanity.excavate.descriptio: Mine an area of blocks at once.
enchantment.arcanity.vein_mining.descrip: Breaks matching, connected blocks when mining.
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: Increases damage against arthropods such as Spiders and Silverfish.
enchantment.minecraft.blast_protection.d: Reduces damage from explosions and explosion knockback.
enchantment.minecraft.efficiency.descrip: Increases mining speed of the item.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Reduces the effects of fire damage and the burn time when on fire.
enchantment.minecraft.knockback.descript: Increases the knockback strength of the item.
enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect: Reduces damage from projectiles such as arrows and tridents.
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.descrip: Allows fragile blocks such as glass to be collected.
enchantment.minecraft.smite.description: Increases damage against undead mobs such as Zombies and Skeletons.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.description: Causes damage to enemies when they attack you.
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.descrip: Causes the item to lose durability at a slower rate.
